title: D · 손잡이 도장
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. New inventory ITEM BACKING concept board for DEVIANT ink-and-paper game. User rejected generic beveled icon tiles and badge frames. Create charming clear actual-item identities for FORM stamps and SKILL stamps. Style is clean flat hand-inked illustration, bold black contours, warm ivory face, subtle muted materials, minimum details, ample blank inner area. No ornate fantasy metal, no gloss, no photorealism, no heavy shading, no gameplay numbers. Clear at 48–64px. The backing is shared by all items of that type so empty face must be large, glyph occupies 55–60%. No numbers, prices, rarity stars or tiny text embedded in icon.
Reference1 is CURRENT IN-GAME INK DROP silhouette only: pointed top and broad rounded bottom. Ignore its old white symbols and small round badge. Keep the drop shape/color identity; overlay ONLY approved black bullseye-with-wedge symbol from reference3. Ink is settled; do not redesign it as square/hexagon, bottle or tile. References2/3 are approved monochrome LOGO glyphs. For form use approved rapier glyph; for skill use approved double-slash followup glyph. Preserve simple silhouette style, do not embellish them.
LANDSCAPE board on plain warm ivory with three clearly separated horizontal rows. Row1 label "잉크 · 기존 물방울": small settled baseline, five small drop items (red/yellow/green/blue/purple) with the same bold black bullseye glyph, plus one empty red droplet. Limit ink row to upper 20% of board.
Rows2/3 are hero focus, two columns named "형태 스탬프" and "스킬 스탬프": show a large empty item backing and next to it the SAME backing with its black glyph. The stamp variants should have same visual family but distinct overall silhouettes, obvious without relying on turquoise. They are not two recolors of same frame.
Bottom narrow row "작은 슬롯에서": three form-stamp miniatures with rapier/dagger/whip glyphs, and three skill-stamp miniatures with expanding arcs/forward arrow/double slash. Accurate consistent icon scales. Keep all labels outside the asset. No entire game UI screenshot. Avoid excessive decorative borders or icon highlight shines.  Header "D · 손잡이 도장". Main idea: instantly recognize a RUBBER STAMP tool through its compact rounded handle visible above a broad pale stamp body. FRONT ELEVATION, not side or perspective, so black glyph readable on a LARGE pale front face. FORM item: short muted walnut knob, broad clipped-square ivory base, strong simple silhouette. SKILL item: short charcoal mushroom knob, wide capsule ivory base with tiny turquoise top collar. Handle is only 20% of total height, broad face is 65%; no narrow stem taking all room. These are clean graphic actual objects not app tiles. The glyph is printed on face as identifying label, do not draw stamped paper beneath.
